tasks.short: Report search performance, explain changes and help marketing leaders choose actions.

steps.what: Select reporting periods, segments and measures in the {BI}.
Combine campaign changes and content releases in a {SPREADSHEET} activity ledger.
Write explanations of performance changes and measurement limits in the {DOCS}.

loop.input: Report snapshot, activity ledger and measurement caveats.
loop.output: Candidate explanations with source references, uncertainties and competing explanations.
loop.check: Recalculate numeric claims; the strategist checks explanations and removes unsupported causal claims.
loop.stop: One proposal and one correction pass; unresolved explanations return to the strategist.
loop.why_not_simpler: Rules can flag changes but cannot reliably interpret campaign context and conflicting explanations.

steps.what: Prepare an executive report with findings, caveats and proposed actions in the {DOCS}.

loop.input: Accepted diagnosis note, report snapshot and reporting brief.
loop.output: Executive report draft with proposed actions and linked evidence.
loop.check: Populate figures deterministically; the strategist approves wording, caveats and recommendations.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; use the populated report template if drafting fails.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates handle figures, but a useful executive narrative depends on the period's findings.

steps.what: Discuss findings and agree priorities with the marketing manager.
Share the approved report and decision record through the {EMAIL}.

tasks.design: Configure reporting views in the {BI} using the certified dataset from the metrics task, and join change logs through the {DATA_PLATFORM}. A bounded drafting service prepares explanations and an executive report in the {DOCS}; the strategist approves publication, and the {WORKFLOW} distributes the approved material through the {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reporting often combines reusable charts with manually assembled change histories and contextual explanations.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing reporting features handle recurring views. AI-assisted coding reduces the effort of building adapters and report generators; bounded drafting can work from verified figures.
tasks.still_hard: Attribution gaps, seasonality and simultaneous changes make causal explanations uncertain. Leadership trade-offs still require discussion.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge attractive explanations, distinguish evidence from speculation and make recommendations relevant to leadership decisions.

ambition.what: Trigger-based stop-or-invest reviews for underperforming search themes

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from assembling reports to investigating exceptions and preparing decisions. The strategist gains no automatic budget authority; delegated limits would allow quicker experiments.

reach.learn: Contribution margins, budget constraints and the evidence needed to change channel investment.

evidence.claim: Scheduled reports, change-log integrations and dashboards are established deterministic patterns; this is not a documented search-marketing case.
A documented report failure involving invented references supports checking generated narrative against source material.

assumptions: Time shares and remaining percentages are planning estimates, informed by the supplied priors.
This task consumes the certified dataset from the metrics task; baseline ingestion is not built twice.
Build ranges are working-day estimates for one reporting scope and reusable templates.
Access estimates include permission checks and any applicable employee consultation under national rules; consultation can extend elapsed time.
GDPR and EU AI Act applicability are assessed for the actual deployment; individual employee monitoring is outside this design.
unknowns: Existing reporting views, licences and change-log export access.
Who approves executive reports and who may receive commercial results.
Current reporting effort and which reports actually support decisions.
Whether the proposed trigger-based review already exists.
research_questions: Which explanations recur often enough to encode as deterministic checks?
Which leadership decisions require a narrative rather than a dashboard alert?
new_work: Review generated explanations and verify evidence links.
Maintain reporting definitions, distribution lists and source mappings.
Handle missing change logs and stale datasets.
Remove reports that no longer support a decision.

tasks.short: Improve website copy, metadata and media for search visibility and device usability.

steps.what: Audit pages using an {OTHER} SEO crawler and record technical issues.
Prioritize page changes against search intent and business goals in the {DOCS}.
Revise headings, page copy, metadata and image descriptions in the {DOCS}.

loop.input: Page brief, existing content, approved claims and relevant media assets.
loop.output: Proposed copy, metadata and image descriptions with a source-linked change list.
loop.check: Check required fields and links automatically; the strategist verifies accuracy, intent and image descriptions.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision per page; missing evidence or unclear images return to manual editing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Mechanical substitutions cannot preserve meaning or write useful descriptions across varied pages.

steps.what: Resize and compress media in an {OTHER} media editor.
Enter approved copy and media into a draft in the {CMS}.
Check page previews for layout, accessibility, meaning and mobile usability in the {CMS}.
Approve and publish the revised page through the {CMS}.
Check released pages and their subsequent performance in the {BI}.

tasks.design: Configure scheduled audits in the {OTHER} SEO crawler and media presets in the {OTHER} media editor. A bounded copy generator uses approved material in the {DOCS}, while a deterministic integration fills drafts in the {CMS}; a person checks previews and approves publication. The {BI} monitors releases using the shared metric dataset.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technical checks were already available, but varied page content, manual transfers and editorial checks kept the work fragmented.
tasks.enabler_now: Configurable audits and media presets handle mechanical changes. AI-assisted coding makes draft integrations cheaper, while bounded drafting can propose revisions from approved sources.
tasks.still_hard: Search relevance, truthful claims, visual cropping and actual accessibility need contextual checks. Ranking changes are delayed and cannot be guaranteed.
tasks.human_edge: Understand what visitors need, preserve meaning and judge whether a page is useful and credible.

ambition.what: Pre-publication search and mobile readiness checks for campaign editors

tasks.altitude: The strategist spends more time selecting valuable changes and testing page quality. They can recommend readiness standards, but publishing rights remain subject to explicit delegation.

reach.learn: Editorial structure, source verification and how to preserve an author's intended meaning.

reach.task: Evaluate a landing page on mobile devices.
reach.learn: Responsive layouts, keyboard use, readable content and the limits of automated accessibility checks.

evidence.claim: Shopify Sidekick generates product descriptions; this supports bounded copy drafting, not automatic SEO improvement or publication.
Technical audits, media presets, draft imports and publication approvals can use configuration and deterministic code.
Human review remains useful for search intent, factual claims and usability; the digest supplies no case quantifying this task's savings.

assumptions: Time shares and remaining percentages are planning estimates, informed by the supplied priors.
The initial scope uses existing page templates and approved assets; template redesign is separate.
Media presets handle resizing and compression; meaningful cropping remains part of preview review.
Build ranges cover a representative page family and working days, with reusable briefs and checklists.
Access estimates include publishing permissions and any applicable consultation under national rules; elapsed consultation may take longer.
GDPR and EU AI Act applicability are checked for the deployment; drafting inputs exclude unnecessary personal data.
unknowns: Draft interfaces, staging support and rollback facilities in the {CMS}.
Who has publishing authority and whether claims require another specialist's approval.
Page volumes, languages and accessibility requirements.
Whether editors already receive a readiness-check service.
research_questions: Which issue types can be fixed with existing configuration?
Which copy changes pass editorial review without substantial rewriting?
Which automated checks predict real mobile usability problems?
new_work: Review proposed copy and maintain approved claims.
Check previews and handle ambiguous image descriptions or crops.
Maintain page-field mappings, media presets and acceptance checklists.
Investigate release alerts and restore earlier versions when needed.

tasks.short: Collect web and campaign metrics, reconcile definitions and identify reliable performance signals.

steps.what: Export metrics from an {OTHER} web analytics service, the {ADS} and conversion records.
Align dates, campaign identifiers, currencies and channel labels in a {SPREADSHEET}.
Reconcile totals, duplicates and attribution differences against source summaries in a {SPREADSHEET}.
Calculate conversion rates, acquisition costs and segment comparisons in the {BI}.
Investigate anomalies and accept usable measurements with caveats in the {DOCS}.
Save accepted measurements and caveats as a reusable dataset in the {BI}.

tasks.design: Configure scheduled imports from the {OTHER} web analytics service, the {ADS} and the relevant {CRM} or {ECOMMERCE} conversion source into the {DATA_PLATFORM}. Deterministic transformations reconcile identifiers and definitions, then feed the {BI} with validated measures and an exception queue. The strategist resolves material exceptions before the dataset is released for reporting and planning.
tasks.previous_blocker: Different identifiers, attribution windows and conversion definitions often make available exports difficult to combine reliably.
tasks.enabler_now: Scheduled connectors and calculated measures already exist. AI-assisted coding reduces the effort of implementing source mappings, reconciliation checks and regression checks.
tasks.still_hard: Consent-related gaps, cross-device journeys, delayed conversions and changing tracking definitions remain. Clean calculations do not establish incremental marketing impact.
tasks.human_edge: Decide whether a measurement is fit for a decision and distinguish tracking changes from changes in customer behaviour.

ambition.what: Daily measurement-health triage before campaign changes

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from joining exports to diagnosing measurement failures and advising colleagues on uncertainty. The strategist can recommend pausing decisions based on unreliable data; campaign authority requires separate delegation.

reach.role: Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists
reach.task: Assess whether an observed conversion change supports a market conclusion.
reach.learn: Sampling bias, uncertainty, experimental design and the difference between attribution and causation.

evidence.claim: Scheduled ingestion, deterministic reconciliation and calculated dashboards are established patterns for structured marketing data.
Tracking gaps and attribution differences require explicit measurement definitions; a model loop is unnecessary for the core calculations.
GDPR applies where analytics records contain personal data; aggregation does not remove obligations on the underlying collection.

assumptions: Time shares and remaining percentages are planning estimates, informed by the supplied priors.
Use the {CRM} or {ECOMMERCE} as appropriate; their conversion totals are not blindly added together.
Existing connectors support scheduled access; a custom adapter would increase coding and integration effort.
Build ranges cover one agreed measurement scope and are working-day estimates.
Access estimates include data permissions, privacy review and applicable consultation under national rules; elapsed consultation can take longer.
The design uses minimum necessary data, controlled retention and aggregate reporting, without individual employee monitoring.
GDPR and EU AI Act applicability are checked for the actual deployment.
unknowns: Available source interfaces, licences and historical data.
The accepted conversion source, revenue definition and attribution window.
Current consent coverage, retention rules and lawful processing arrangements.
How much reconciliation is already automated.
Whether daily measurement triage would change campaign decisions.
research_questions: Which source differences reflect definitions rather than data defects?
What tolerances distinguish delayed conversions from broken collection?
Which metrics remain useful when tracking coverage changes?
new_work: Resolve unmatched campaign identifiers and material reconciliation exceptions.
Maintain metric definitions and version source mappings.
Monitor freshness, missing fields and changes in source interfaces.
Record tracking changes and review access and retention settings.

tasks.short: Develop online marketing choices, secure agreement and turn approved strategy into campaigns.

steps.what: Review performance, customer evidence and business priorities in the {BI} and {DOCS}.
Compare channel budgets and outcome scenarios in a {SPREADSHEET}.
Draft a strategy proposal and test plan in the {DOCS}.

loop.input: Evidence pack, calculated scenarios, brand guidelines and delivery constraints.
loop.output: Options, a proposed test plan, assumptions and unanswered questions.
loop.check: Link factual claims to evidence; the strategist checks feasibility, differentiation and test validity.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported options remain labelled hypotheses or are removed.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template organizes the proposal but cannot synthesize varied research into coherent options.

steps.what: Discuss options, challenge assumptions and resolve delivery trade-offs with the marketing team.
Approve the strategy, budget envelope and success criteria.
Create delivery tasks, owners and dependencies in the {PROJECT}.
Check and activate approved campaigns in the {ADS}.

tasks.design: Reuse verified evidence from the {BI} and {DOCS}, then calculate budget scenarios with deterministic code on the {DATA_PLATFORM}. A bounded loop drafts options and test plans in the {DOCS}, while people resolve trade-offs and approve commitments. The {PROJECT} creates delivery tasks from the approved plan, and configured checks in the {ADS} support separately approved activation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence collection and scenario paperwork were mixed with strategic judgement. Automating the whole task would leave unclear who chooses the trade-offs.
tasks.enabler_now: Shared datasets and reusable scenario calculations remove preparation work. Bounded drafting can organize evidence and alternatives without receiving spending authority.
tasks.still_hard: Demand uncertainty, channel interaction, organisational capacity and weak experiments can undermine a plausible plan. Agreement depends on people accepting real trade-offs.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a differentiated direction, expose uncomfortable assumptions and build commitment across people with competing goals.

ambition.what: Search-intent pilots for upcoming product launches

tasks.altitude: The strategist spends more time designing tests and discussing choices with product and marketing colleagues. With explicit delegation, they could choose experiments inside an approved budget envelope; larger commitments remain with the marketing manager.

reach.task: Design a campaign test with spending limits and stop criteria.
reach.learn: Media planning, creative testing, marginal returns and approval responsibilities.
Positioning, commercial priorities, capacity constraints and portfolio trade-offs.

evidence.claim: Evidence packs, scenario calculations and delivery templates can be built deterministically; strategic choices still require judgement.
Bounded drafting can prepare alternatives from supplied evidence, but the digest provides no documented marketing-strategy outcome case.
Configured campaign controls can separate preparation from authorization to spend and publish.

assumptions: Time shares and remaining percentages are planning estimates, informed by the supplied priors.
Scenario outputs are conditional calculations, not causal forecasts or promised returns.
The shared metric and reporting components are reused; their build effort is not repeated here.
Creative production and landing-page work occur in their own workflows.
The strategist checks activation under explicitly delegated rights; otherwise that gate belongs to the marketing manager.
Build ranges are working-day estimates for one planning template and campaign workflow.
Access estimates include budget permissions and applicable consultation under national rules; elapsed consultation can take longer.
GDPR and EU AI Act applicability are assessed for actual data and targeting uses.
unknowns: Budget approval thresholds and delegated campaign activation rights.
Existing planning templates and campaign approval capabilities.
Available margin data, research quality and experiment capacity.
Whether product teams already receive search-intent launch pilots.
Any personal data, restricted targeting or employee monitoring introduced by the deployment.
research_questions: Which scenario assumptions materially change the preferred strategy?
What evidence would make the team stop a pilot rather than extend it?
Which product-launch decision could search-intent evidence actually change?
new_work: Maintain scenario assumptions and reusable test templates.
Review draft options for unsupported claims and impractical delivery demands.
Keep budget limits, activation permissions and approval records current.
Evaluate completed pilots and retire unhelpful experiments.

role.altitude: The role shifts toward measurement judgement, useful content and controlled marketing experiments. Decision rights expand only through explicit delegation of publishing and experiment budgets.
reach: Prepare channel investment recommendations with Marketing Managers.
Evaluate mobile landing pages with Web and Digital Interface Designers.
Design interpretable experiments with Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists.
skills_to_grow: Metric definitions, reconciliation and privacy-aware measurement
Editorial judgement, accessibility and mobile usability
Commercial scenario analysis and budget trade-offs
Maintaining integrations, validation rules and bounded drafting checks
role.ambitious_version: Offer a reusable search experiment service: validate measurement, prepare a useful landing page, test a search-intent hypothesis and recommend investment based on evidence. Portable templates and checks provide the head start; local access, data definitions and delegated authority complete the setup.
